summary: Comprehensive testing of MealTrack nutritional planning app. Backend APIs are mostly functional (8/9 tests passed), frontend UI renders correctly, but frontend-backend integration has critical issues preventing user signup/login completion.

critical_bugs.issue: Request timeout after 60s during AI plan generation
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot complete the nutrition plan generation flow
critical_bugs.note: Expected behavior as AI generation takes 30-60s, but needs better timeout handling

ui_bugs.issue: Form submission hangs in 'Criando conta...' state and never completes
ui_bugs.details: Button becomes disabled and shows loading state but signup never completes or shows errors

ui_bugs.issue: Login form submission not redirecting to dashboard
ui_bugs.details: Form stays on login page even with valid credentials

integration_issues.issue: Frontend signup not properly integrating with backend API
integration_issues.details: API endpoint is reachable (200 OK) but frontend form submission process is failing

integration_issues.issue: Login process not establishing proper session
integration_issues.details: Backend login API works but frontend doesn't redirect to dashboard

passed_tests: Landing page loads with hero section
All form fields are present and fillable
Assessment form progress bar and navigation
Backend API endpoints (8/9) including auth, assessments, plans
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix frontend authentication flow - signup and login forms are not properly integrating with backend APIs. Forms hang in loading state and don't redirect to dashboard. Investigation needed in AuthContext.js signup/login methods and error handling.

success_percentage.frontend: 60% (UI renders correctly but critical auth flows broken)
